messages:
Maya (CS): FYI — just wrapped a call with Solara Health. A handful of product asks and a couple onboarding pain points. Capturing here so we can triage.
Jon (PM): thanks — can you paste the raw asks?
Maya (CS): Sure. Quick list from the convo: 1) Per-route cost breakdown in billing UI 2) A toggle to disable embeddings for certain routes 3) Clearer onboarding checklist for dedicated deployments (networking/KMS steps) 4) Alert when model rollouts change latency for their routes.
Lina (CSE): re #3 — they got stuck on the KMS key policy step. Said docs assume Terraform. They want an option checklist for console-only setup.
Eli (Eng): noted. For #1 we already have backend events but no customer-facing aggregation. Would need a per-route aggregation job + UI. Rough effort: 2 sprints.
Jon (PM): prioritize — which of these is blocking renewal or causing actual outage?
Maya (CS): Solara is mid-trial, renewal not immediate but onboarding delays are delaying production cutover. #3 is the blocker. #1 and #2 are product asks they'd like in time for scale but not blockers. #4 is a trust/observability ask — medium pain.
Jon (PM): OK. T-shirt priority: #3 = P0 (onboarding blocker), #4 = P2, #1 = P2, #2 = P3.
Maya (CS): they also gave a small UX idea: in the per-route page show a compact "estimated monthly" metric based on current traffic. They said it would help their finance folks forecast.
Lina (CSE): can we capture a sample of routes + volume? If they share a CSV I can mock the UI quickly.
Maya (CS): asked them to drop a sanitized export. They replied in-thread with a little CSV snippet. Pasting below (sanitized):
```
route_id,avg_daily_calls,avg_tokens_per_call
checkout/price,1200,45
search/query,4300,12
user/msg,220,300
```
Maya (CS): they said the checkout route is the big surprise — tokens there spike on rare promotions.
Eli (Eng): for the estimated monthly metric we can surface a simple projection: monthly = avg_daily_calls * avg_tokens_per_call * 30. Add a confidence flag if variance > 3x. Can prototype in the metrics microfrontend in ~3 days.
Jon (PM): nice. Action items: 1) Lina to draft console-only onboarding checklist doc + add to onboarding repo (due EOD Fri) 2) Eli to spike UI prototype for estimated monthly metric (3d) 3) PM to create product ticket for per-route billing aggregation (depends on infra estimate) 4) CS to ask Solara for sanitized export + permission to run a quick pilot (Maya)
Lina (CSE): taking item 1. I'll post a PR link when ready.
Eli (Eng): taking item 2. I'll add a short design mock and link to a staging branch.
Maya (CS): I will ask for the export and confirm pilot window. Also asked about "disable embeddings per route" — they'd prefer a toggle vs creating a separate model.
Jon (PM): add a short spec for toggles vs model variant routing. We need to evaluate complexity.
feedback-bot: New ticket created: CS-4823 "Solara: onboarding console checklist" (assigned Lina).
Maya (CS): pinging @Lina — if you want I can share the call notes and the recorded snippet where they showed the KMS console flow.
Lina (CSE): please share recording, that will speed the doc. :thumbsup:
Jon (PM): I'll slot a 30m sync next week to review spike artifacts.
Maya (CS): Solara said they'd be willing to do a pilot for the estimated monthly metric on staging next Tuesday. I'll coordinate.
Eli (Eng): OK. I'll try to have the prototype by Monday so we can test on Tue.
Maya (CS): thanks team. Updating the customer tracker and tagging this thread in the onboard-signal board.
Lina (CSE): PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/onboard-checklists/pull/412 (draft).
Maya (CS): added meeting invite for Tue 9am PT.
Jon (PM): marking ticket priorities in Productboard.
Maya (CS): closing loop here for now. Will reopen thread if Solara adds more asks. :white_check_mark:
